question: In July 2023, Tribhuvaneshwar Saran Singh Deo was appointed as Deputy Chief Minister of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Tribhuvaneshwar Saran Singh Deo was appointed as the Deputy Chief Minister of **Chhattisgarh** in July 2023.
 
• This decision was made as part of the state’s political restructuring ahead of the upcoming legislative assembly elections.
 
• He previously served as the Health Minister and has been a significant figure in the state’s politics.
 
• His appointment is seen as a strategic move to strengthen the party’s position in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chhattisgarh:**

 
 
• Chhattisgarh is a state located in central India, known for its rich cultural heritage and mineral resources.
 
• The state was formed on November 1, 2000, after being separated from Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Raipur is the capital city of Chhattisgarh.
 
• The state is divided into 28 districts and has a legislative assembly with 90 seats.
 
 
 
• **Political Landscape:**
 
 
• Chhattisgarh has a multi-party political system, with the Indian National Congress (INC) and the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) being the two major parties.
 
• The state has seen significant political activity and leadership changes over the years.
 
 
 
• **Tribhuvaneshwar Saran Singh Deo:**
 
 
• He is a prominent politician from Chhattisgarh and a member of the Indian National Congress.
 
• He has served in various capacities, including Health Minister and now Deputy Chief Minister.
 
• He is known for his contributions to the state's healthcare sector.
